title: Raspberry Pineapple E-Liquid 60ml (3000mg)
description:
Introducing our premium CBD E-liquid, a heavenly blend of relaxation and flavour: Raspberry Pineapple
Crafted with care, our CBD E-liquid boasts an 80% PG (Propylene Glycol) and 20% VG (Vegetable Glycerin) composition, ensuring a smooth and satisfying vaping experience. The Raspberry Pineapple flavour is a whimsical journey into the sweet nostalgia of Raspberries and Pineapple, providing a luscious and enjoyable cloud with every inhale.
Unwind and treat your senses to the perfect fusion of CBD goodness and sugary delight. Embrace relaxation with each puff of our Raspberry Pineapple CBD E-liquid – where tranquillity meets taste in a bottle designed for your ultimate enjoyment.
